nodes.description: Public state variable 'owner' holding the current contract owner address; set from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Public state variable 'newOwner' used in the two-step ownership transfer handshake.
Public token symbol string, initialised to '3H40'.
Public token name string, initialised to 'IP Token'.
Public uint8 decimals value, initialised to 18.
Public _totalSupply holding the minted supply assigned to the deployer address.
Mapping(address => uint) balances recording token holdings of each account.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed storing ERC20 allowances.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance indexing and allowance indexing.
SafeMath.safeAdd: adds two uints and requires the result not to overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub: subtracts two uints and requires the subtrahend not to exceed the minuend.
SafeMath.safeMul: multiplies two uints and requires the product to be consistent.
SafeMath.safeDiv: divides two uints and requires the divisor to be non-zero.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner), restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then finalises the ownership handover.
IPToken constructor minting the whole supply to a fixed address and emitting Transfer.
totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view returning the stored balance.
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): overwrites the caller's allowance for spender.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves tokens using the caller's allowance.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view returning the remaining allowance.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
Owner-only rescue function forwarding an external ERC20 transfer to the owner address.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) made after the allowance update.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary caller-supplied token contract.
Addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded by require(c >= a).
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded by the overflow consistency check.
Parameter 'to' of transfer(): destination address for the token movement.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer(): amount to move, fed into safeSub/safeAdd.
Parameter 'spender' of approve(): address granted the allowance.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve(): allowance amount stored in allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(): account debited and allowance owner.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(): account credited with the tokens.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom(): amount debited from balance and allowance.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall(): allowance grantee and external call target.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall(): allowance amount and value forwarded to the callback.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall(): opaque bytes forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token(): untrusted external contract called.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token(): amount forwarded to the external token.
Parameter '_newOwner' of transferOwnership(): pending owner stored in newOwner.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf(): address key into the balances mapping.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of allowance(): outer key into the allowed mapping.
Parameter 'spender' of allowance(): inner key into the allowed mapping.
Parameter 'a' of safeAdd(): first operand of the guarded addition.
Parameter 'b' of safeAdd(): second operand of the guarded addition.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
The _newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership assigns newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
msg.sender is used as the key when reading/writing the balances mapping in transfer, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
msg.sender is the outer key of the allowed mapping in approve and transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter of transfer indexes the balances mapping that is credited.
The 'to' parameter of transferFrom indexes the credited balance entry.
The 'from' parameter of transferFrom indexes the debited balance entry.
transfer passes the 'tokens' parameter into safeSub when debiting balances[msg.sender].
transfer passes the 'tokens' parameter into safeAdd when crediting balances[to].
transferFrom passes 'tokens' into safeSub for both the balance and the allowance deduction.
transferFrom passes 'tokens' into safeAdd when crediting the destination.
The caller-controlled 'spender' becomes the target contract of the receiveApproval external call.
'tokens' is forwarded as an argument to the external receiveApproval callback.
The opaque 'data' parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external callback.
The caller-supplied tokenAddress becomes the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
'tokens' is forwarded as the amount to the external ERC20 transfer.
Operand 'a' flows into the guarded addition inside safeAdd.
Operand 'b' flows into the guarded addition inside safeAdd.
safeAdd executes the addition operation and its overflow require check.
safeSub executes the subtraction and the require(b <= a) guard.
safeMul executes the multiplication and its consistency require check.
transfer calls safeAdd when crediting the destination balance.
transfer calls safeSub when debiting the sender balance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the destination balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the source balance and the allowance.
The onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership compares msg.sender with owner before executing.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, gating the ownership handover.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier checking msg.sender.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance owner and callback argument.
transfer operates on the balances entry selected by msg.sender.
approve writes the allowance entry keyed by msg.sender.
transferFrom consumes the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
approveAndCall performs an external callback into the spender contract after the allowance write.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
The IPToken constructor initialises the symbol state variable.
The IPToken constructor initialises the name state variable.
The IPToken constructor initialises the decimals state variable.
The IPToken constructor sets the whole supply into _totalSupply.
The IPToken constructor mints the entire supply into balances of the fixed address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply before subtracting balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the requested owner.
transfer writes the updated sender and recipient balances.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decreases the allowance in the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before invoking the external callback.
The tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf is the key into the balances mapping.
The tokenOwner parameter of allowance is the outer key of the allowed mapping.
The spender parameter of allowance is the inner key of the allowed mapping.
The spender parameter of approve becomes the inner allowance key.
The tokens parameter of approve is stored as the allowance value.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument into the external receiveApproval callback.

normalization_plan.reason: Non-core destination parameter is only meaningful as an operand of transfer's balance credit.
Non-core amount parameter is consumed by transfer's safeSub/safeAdd calls.
Non-core spender parameter is only used as the allowance key written by approve.
Non-core amount parameter is only stored into allowed by approve.
Non-core source parameter is only the debited key inside transferFrom.
Non-core destination parameter is only the credited key inside transferFrom.
Non-core amount parameter feeds both balance and allowance deductions in transferFrom.
Non-core spender parameter is the external callback target of approveAndCall.
Non-core amount parameter is the allowance value and callback argument of approveAndCall.
Non-core data blob is forwarded unchanged into the external receiveApproval call.
Non-core tokenAddress parameter is the untrusted call target of the external ERC20 transfer.
Non-core tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external ERC20 contract.
Non-core pending-owner parameter is only stored into newOwner by transferOwnership.
Non-core lookup key is only read against balances inside balanceOf.
Non-core outer lookup key is only read against allowed inside allowance.
Non-core inner lookup key is only read against allowed inside allowance.
Non-core first operand exists solely for the guarded addition in safeAdd.
Non-core second operand exists solely for the guarded addition in safeAdd.
